https://github.com/esphome/esphome — components/pzem004t/pzem004t.cpp: independent implementation, same 0xA0–0xA5 response headers, same 7-byte frame with 'byte 6: checksum (sum of other bytes)', same four quantities
https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pzem004t/ and https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pzemac/ — ESPHome ships two separate components for the two protocols, which is itself evidence the map forked

transport: 5 V TTL UART · 9600 baud · NOT Modbus. Fixed 7-byte request and 7-byte response frames with an 8-bit additive checksum (sum of the preceding bytes, low byte). The meter is addressed by a 4-byte address carried in the request and handled as an IPAddress by both libraries; the factory default value was not confirmed by a source and is left unrecorded.
blocks: No registers. Command bytes 0xB0 voltage, 0xB1 current, 0xB2 power, 0xB3 energy, 0xB4 set address, 0xB5 power alarm; matching response headers 0xA0–0xA5. One request per quantity — four round trips for a full reading, against one for the v3.0 map.
refutedOnReview: The register map is real; the two-model grouping is not. gotchas: This is a genuine protocol fork inside one product name, not a revision of one map. A v1/v2 unit will not answer a Modbus read at all, and a v3.0 unit will not answer 0xB0. There is no address or scale here that can be carried across from the pzem-ac-014-016-004t-v3 dialect.

Recorded so nobody researches it twice. No Quebec listing surveyed was confirmed to be v1 or v2 — this dialect exists to explain why the unversioned listings are unresolvable, and it is the reason they are.
No vendor protocol document was located for v1/v2. Confidence is community-crosschecked on two independent implementations agreeing, and should not be upgraded without one.
Filed under modbus-rs485 to sit beside its siblings; the protocol is neither Modbus nor RS-485. The family label here is a filing decision only.
unmappedReports: Nothing. This dialect reports strictly fewer quantities than MetricKind can express — it has no frequency and no power factor at all, which is the measurement gap that makes it unsuitable for watching a generator.
